verdict.rationale: Firecrawl does produce AI-generated output: an AI agent that searches, navigates and retrieves information from a natural-language description, with configurable reasoning effort, plus prompt-driven structured JSON extraction. But this is AI-powered data extraction from web pages delivered via API, not insights or suggestions about the user's own data surfaced inside the product. Missing for 10: AI-generated insights or analysis of user data, proactive suggestions, an in-product (UI) insights experience, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
